status: infra verified; User-side G8 observability delivery awaits controller integration and real combined verification

java.default: disabled; explicit service name, environment, version, HTTP(S) OTLP endpoint and management.tracing.enabled required
java.transport: W3C traceparent propagation through Boot-managed HTTP instrumentation. Malformed traceparent is ignored by the SDK. Controlled servlet outbound propagation uses Boot-managed RestClient.Builder.
java.correlation: traceId/spanId from tracing context; request ID recorded as high-cardinality knode.request_id span attribute only, never a metric label. Servlet filter also binds requestId in MDC during synchronous handling.
java.privacy: No request/response bodies, credential headers, JWT, sid, passwords, or user IDs as instrumentation attributes; baggage disabled in example config. Caller-owned code must not add sensitive values.
java.resource: explicit service.name, service.version and deployment.environment.name configured in template
java.bounds: Gateway SDK max queue 512 spans, max batch 128, schedule 1s, export timeout 2s, connect timeout 1s. Overflow drops spans; observability is best effort.
java.metrics: Spring Boot http.server.requests uses method, status, outcome, exception and a framework route template when available; Gateway may report UNKNOWN. Histogram enabled. Never add raw path IDs, user IDs, sids or request IDs as metric labels.
java.management: Expose health and prometheus on an explicitly configured loopback management address and independent port; do not expose prometheus via a public gateway route.
java.enabledServices: Gateway wired and disabled by default; User-side G8 observability wiring is delivered and disabled by default, pending controller integration and real combined verification. Agent business integration remains pending.

python: Independent FastAPI fixture uses existing read-only yan_agent.observability.tracing with W3C and OTLP HTTP. OTEL_BSP_* and OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TRACES_TIMEOUT in the environment template bound its queue and HTTP timeout. This does not prove the Agent business pipeline.
async: See contracts/shared/observability/trace-context.json. Synthetic Java/Redis-protocol-substitute fixture and Collector/Jaeger paths are verified separately. User-side v2 producer implementation is delivered; real User Outbox to Redis Stream chain awaits combined verification.

collector.receiver: OTLP gRPC and HTTP on loopback by default
collector.overflow: drop or reject telemetry; no business request should wait on exporter

local: Collector, Jaeger and Prometheus config and pinned official Windows-native sources: deploy/microservices/observability/; binaries and test evidence remain untracked.
health: Gateway and service health do not depend on telemetry export. Collector health_check reports its own process state and is not proof that Jaeger has received spans.
